review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector for Decagon; prevents infinite loops and truncated exports by enforcing page-boundary checks and parsing reported totals.
review.reason: Adds page-boundary checks and page-cap enforcement to the Decagon warehouse connector, replacing a page-count-only termination with a total-derived bound and a constant page-cap fallback.
